lines.trans: You've seen everything circulating online about Huimei, right — claiming she is secretly married?
Both of us know her well; how could anything like that be true? It's utterly absurd.
Do you know what the story is with that child?
I don't know either. Our team asked, in fact, though she refused to discuss it.
Regardless, that child is definitely not hers, and she must have her own reasons for staying silent.
Huimei was just chosen as regional ambassador for an international brand, and now they want to terminate her contract.
They claim she damaged the independent-woman image their brand wants to project.
Losing the fee is minor, whereas lasting damage to her reputation will hurt her entire career.
I already heard about the contract issue.
Speaking frankly, Xingtian's talent management unit is far too weak — I hope you will step in personally.
I was the one who brought Huimei to Xingtian; it is my responsibility, so rest assured.
Sorry to disturb you so early in the morning — I'll head out now.
